title: Traffic analysis
subtitle: Trace traffic sources, separate internal visits and crawlers, and inspect reading activity.
honestMetrics: HTTP requests, browser page views and article reads are different measurements. They are never added together as visitors.
historyNotice: External browsers are not verified people. Historical visits without hostname or browser context remain unclassified. Zero reading time alone does not prove a bot.
searchHint: Article, path, domain, campaign or User-Agent
filterNotice: Apply filters to update every chart, summary and export.
pageDefinition: One record per session and path
contentDefinition: One record per session and article
visitorDefinition: Account IDs or anonymous session IDs, not people
requestDefinition: Edge requests, including crawlers; tracked separately
sessionDefinition: Session storage IDs, not unique devices
engagedDefinition: Recorded duration; missing exit updates can undercount
scrollDefinition: Recorded article scroll, including zero values
classificationTitle: What is included in these numbers?
classificationNotice: Classification totals respect the other filters but include every traffic class. Inspect a class to filter all analysis below.
top30: Top 30 results. Export or search to inspect all matching records.
deviceNotice: Record counts depend on the selected measurement. Missing device context is shown as unknown.
noCampaigns: No UTM campaign was recorded for these visits.
edgeNotice: Country and network data are collected only for new document HTTP requests.
conversionNotice: Events matched by the same session ID and date range. These are event counts, not a causal or unique-person conversion funnel.
coverageNotice: Country and network describe HTTP requests only. Browser context is client reported. Historical missing values cannot be reconstructed without external evidence.
accountsNotice: Admins are always internal. Mark test or staff accounts with a reason; the rule also classifies their historical signed-in visits. Counts beside accounts are all-time browser page views / article reads.
reasonHint: Describe the evidence; do not infer a bot from zero duration alone.
accountReasonHint: e.g. development QA or staff testing
exportTooLarge: Narrow the date range to export fewer than 100,000 records.
exportChanged: Records changed during export. Refresh and try again.

evidenceKeys.edge_verified_bot: Verified bot signal from the edge
evidenceKeys.no_known_automation_signal: Public hostname; no known bot signal (not proof of a person)
evidenceKeys.missing_historical_context: Missing collection context; identity cannot be determined

sessionHint: Inspect all records in a single browser session
